test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding direct speech.

The official said that only if the forms were submitted on time would the applications be processed.

options.text: "The applications would be processed only if the forms were submitted on time," said the official.
"Only if the forms were submitted on time would the applications be processed," said the official.
"If forms are submitted on time, the applications would be processed," said the official.
"Submit forms on time and your applications will be processed," said the official.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct Speech:** "Only if the forms were submitted on time would the applications be processed," said the official.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Retention of Tense (Conditionals):**
 
 
• Hypothetical or Type 2 conditional sentences (using past tense "were submitted" and conditional "would be") often remain unchanged when converting between direct and indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Retention of Structure (Inversion):**
 
 
• When a sentence begins with a restrictive condition like "Only if," it requires subject-auxiliary inversion in the main clause. The structure "would the applications be processed" accurately reflects this rule and matches the indirect prompt exactly.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb and conjunction:**
 
 
• The conjunction "that" is removed.
 
• The reporting clause ("said the official") is placed outside the quotation marks, separated by a comma.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• The spoken words are enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• The sentence starts with a capital letter "Only".
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Only if the forms were submitted on time would the applications be processed," said the official.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The applications would be processed only if the forms were submitted on time," said the official.

 
 
• While grammatically acceptable, it unnecessarily changes the clause order from the original indirect sentence, losing the structural emphasis of starting with "Only if."
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "If forms are submitted on time, the applications would be processed," said the official.
 
 
• Contains a tense mismatch ("are submitted" with "would be"), misses the definite article "the," and loses the restrictive meaning of "only if."
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Submit forms on time and your applications will be processed," said the official.
 
 
• Changes the fundamental structure from a conditional statement to an imperative command, altering the formal tone and meaning.
